title: Conservative Majority Victory: Conservatives win 64 seats; gas expansion faces C$13.3bn deficit
summary_full: In a significant political shift, British Columbia has ushered in a Conservative majority government after a decade dominated by the New Democratic Party. Winning 64 out of 93 seats, the Conservatives plan to place a strong emphasis on expanding liquefied natural gas production to enhance energy policy. However, they face fiscal constraints with potential deficits looming, and the new government will need to balance economic growth with public service demands.
